key_insight: AVGen-Bench provides a task-driven, multi-granular benchmark that measures joint audio+video correctness for text-to-audio-video generation using high-quality prompts across 11 real-world categories, exposing gaps that coarse embedding metrics miss.
problem_solved: Existing evaluations treat audio and video separately or rely on coarse similarity scores, failing to capture fine-grained, cross-modal and temporal correctness required by realistic prompts; AVGen-Bench fills this gap with targeted tasks and multi-level metrics.
method: Curated 11 real-world prompt categories and high-quality, task-driven prompts that require joint audio–video fidelity and alignment.
Multi-granular evaluation suite combining task-level checks, cross-modal alignment metrics, temporal consistency measures, and human annotations to capture fine-grained correctness.
Baseline evaluation pipeline and protocols to produce reproducible, comparable scores across models and tasks.
impact: Provides AI/ML practitioners a standardized, fine-grained way to evaluate and compare T2AV models, guiding model improvements in joint audio–visual fidelity, alignment, and temporal realism; accelerates progress toward production-ready multimodal generation.
visual_elements: Pipeline diagram: prompt → model outputs (audio+video) → multi-granular metrics → composite score
Side-by-side examples: prompt with ground-truth vs. good/bad generated audio+video frames and waveform snippets
Metric breakdown chart: stacked bar or radar showing task-level, alignment, temporal, and perceptual subscores
Leaderboard mockup comparing baseline models across the 11 categories
paper_title: AVGen-Bench: A Task-Driven Benchmark for Multi-Granular Evaluation of Text-to-Audio-Video Generation
paper_authors: Ziwei Zhou, Zeyuan Lai, Rui Wang, Yifan Yang, Zhen Xing
